evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Scope and behavior are specific (content-identification/fingerprinting) and can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requirement is focused and implementable (profile-based recommendations); estimation is feasible.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Clear collaborative-recommendation scope; effort can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Defines approach (content similarity) and target items, making estimation possible.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Specifies inputs (metadata, image tags) and outcome (discover music); implementable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Clear functional scope (persist tags, make available) and suitable for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Concrete UI/feature requirement; effort can be reasonably sized and planned.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Although generic 'info' could vary, the feature of retrieving/displaying info about similar items is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Specifies perceptual similarity as the matching criterion; implementation effort can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Clear recommender-scope (profile-based) and feasible to estimate effort.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Defines inputs (news events, geolocation) and output (recommendations); estimatable as a feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Although potentially complex, the functionality (person detection/lookup) is specific enough to allow estimation (e.g., MVP vs full recognition).

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Defines a concrete detection-and-enrichment capability; scope is estimate-able (e.g., product detection + metadata lookup).

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection target (logos) and outcome (related info) support reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Concrete detection/enrichment requirement; implementation effort can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Clear input/output (image -> related videos); estimatable functionality.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Feature scope (map, nearby video detection) is concrete enough to estimate, despite 'any other relevant point' being open-ended for future refinement.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Specifies ASR-based search; implementable with clear boundaries and estimatable effort.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped admin UI and editing capability; effort can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Defines inputs and outputs (annotations, topic extraction); estimatable as discrete work items.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Specifies ranking by audio/video quality; although A/V metrics need definition, the feature is concrete enough to estimate at a high level.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection goal (edited audio assessment); scope allows for an implementation estimate (e.g., heuristic/MVP).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Clear functional objective (nudity prefiltering) with established techniques; effort estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Specifies prefilter/search on low-level asset info; implementable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Extremely broad and legally/technically complex (multiple detection strategies, legal rules, external data) without acceptance criteria, making reasonable implementation estimation infeasible.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Clear inputs and mechanism (search on metadata/tags); scoped enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Terms like 'interesting' and 'appealing' are subjective and underspecified; acceptance criteria are lacking, preventing reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Triggers and thresholds for 'should be prompted' are unspecified and subjective, making reasonable estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Definable as clustering/classification of volunteer behavior; scope is estimatable (e.g., metrics, clusters).

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Specifies approach (simple low-level features) and target, enabling effort estimation.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped detection task; implementable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection goal with a clear cause; can be estimated as a defined feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Clear ML preclassification task; estimatable by typical model development sizing.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Specific attributes preclassification; scope is reasonable to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Concrete detection/counting task; estimatable implementation effort.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined CV task (segmentation/localization) with estimatable scope.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Clear binary detection goal; implementation effort can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Specifies measurable attributes (size, orientation); estimatable as defined tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Standard ML preclassification task; scope sufficient for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Defines the processing objective (motion analysis to shorten videos); can be estimated as a concrete implementation.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Specific event-detection task with clear acceptance (time of egg-laying); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Enumerates target features; while varied, these are concrete detection targets and can be scoped/estimated per feature.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Defines a measurable outcome (weight/probability) based on volunteer experience; estimatable modeling work.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Specific artefact types listed; prefiltering rules/algorithms can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Clear detection task (moving/transient objects) and measurable acceptance, enabling estimation.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Concrete audio-processing objective; implementation options allow reasonable effort estimation (filters, denoising).

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping of calls is a defined ML task and can be estimated (algorithms, data prep).

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Specific counting/detection task with measurable acceptance; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified trigger conditions and evaluation criteria for interrupting make reasonable implementation estimation infeasible.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selection criteria for modality are unspecified and subjective; lack of acceptance criteria prevents reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: 'When' to educate is not defined (metrics/thresholds missing), making scope too vague to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Criteria for choosing education modality are unspecified and subjective, so reasonable estimation is not possible.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No definition of education pieces, mapping rules, or triggers; underspecified decision logic prevents accurate estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: 'Interesting' is subjective and no acceptance criteria or signals are given, so scope is too vague to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Triggers and policy for bot comments are unspecified; lacking concrete criteria makes estimation unreliable.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: No defined triggers or granularity for 'when' explanations are required, making implementation scope unclear for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Content requirements and selection logic for bot messages are unspecified and subjective, preventing reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Clustering subjects by similarity is a concrete task; implementation approaches can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Defines inputs (previous experiences) and outputs (project recommendations); estimatable as a recommender feature.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization is a defined deliverable; scope and effort can be estimated (e.g., extractive vs abstractive).
